notes: The proof changes Definition 2 by treating arg as ranging over all arguments. Under the supplied convention arg(1)=0, identity (1) fails: its left side is {1}, whereas its right side is {1,-1}. Consequently, at z=0 the displayed formula yields only 2kπi and misses πi, although sinh(πi)=0. The proof establishes an expanded formula rather than the stated equivalence.
